Package index

All functions

DecantDE()
Contamination-aware DE for one cell type of a multi-sample Seurat object.
RunDecant()
Run Decant on a Seurat object.
ambient_de()
Contamination-aware differential expression on pseudobulk counts.
ambient_global()
Global soup profile: normalised aggregate of the empty-droplet pool.
ambient_structured()
Structured soup profile (lysis diagnostic).
cluster_basis()
Derive a program basis (cluster mean profiles) from the observed cells.
correct_counts()
Remove ambient counts from each cell (mass-conserving).
correct_splice_aware()
Splice-aware layer decontamination.
correct_total_then_split()
Baseline to beat: correct the TOTAL, then split the removal by each cell's own observed unspliced/spliced ratio (what you get if you decontaminate total and naively apportion to layers).
de_ambient_aware()
Decant: test condition on OBSERVED data with the ambient load as a covariate, so condition-correlated ambient is absorbed instead of mistaken for signal.
de_naive()
Naive: subtract ambient point estimate, then test condition per gene.
decant()
Run Decant.
decant_de_experimental()
EXPERIMENTAL and OFF by default: failed its gate (made ambient-driven DE false positives worse via covariate collinearity). Kept only so the negative result is reproducible. Superseded by ambient_de() / DecantDE().
decontx_em()
DecontX-style decontamination (Bayesian-mixture EM, reimplementation).
estimate_rho()
Legacy v0 per-cell rho estimator (superseded).
estimate_rho_allelic()
Allelic rho estimate. Fraction of mismatched-allele reads = rho * P(soup read is from another donor). With pool abundances a_d, for a cell of donor d that probability is (1 - a_d). Invert to recover rho.
estimate_rho_cluster()
Cluster-pooled, absent-gene rho estimator with per-cell shrinkage.
gate_allelic()
GATE: allelic rho error vs a marker-style proxy (here: assuming uniform pool, the naive 1/n_donors correction a non-allelic method would implicitly make).
gate_ambient_de()
GATE: does contamination-aware DE stop ambient leakage while staying calibrated and powerful?
gate_ambient_de_cohort()
GATE: does contamination-aware DE stay calibrated in large cohorts whose counts are not negative binomial?
gate_correction()
GATE: which mass-conserving correction rule is closest to truth?
gate_de()
GATE: false-positive rate on ambient-trap genes (should be low for Decant, inflated for naive) while preserving power on true_de genes. Also reports the NULL-gene false-positive rate: if that is not near alpha the simulator or normalisation is broken and the gate result is meaningless.
gate_diagnose()
GATE: with a clean (oracle) program basis, do recovered lysis weights track the true lysis weights? Reported as rank correlation; clustering noise lowers this in real use.
gate_hier()
GATE: for empty-poor samples, is the pooled soup closer to truth than the independent estimate? For empty-rich samples, are they about equal (pooling should not hurt)?
gate_rho()
GATE: is the cluster/absent-gene rho estimator calibrated, and better than the legacy marker-ratio estimator?
gate_splice()
GATE: does splice-aware beat total-then-split on per-layer recovery, and does it correctly NOT help when ambient is not splice-distinct (negative control)?
gene_species()
Species of each gene from a species-prefixed feature name.
pool_soup()
Empirical-Bayes-style shrinkage of per-sample soup profiles.
print(<decant>)
Print a decant result.
quick_labels()
Default clustering used when the caller supplies none.
read_10x_counts()
Read a 10x Genomics matrix directory into a sparse matrix.
run_benchmark()
Global vs structured soup benchmark.
score_correction()
Score a corrected matrix against ground truth.
score_species_mix()
Score decontamination on a species-mixing experiment (full matrix).
simulate_allelic()
Simulate a pooled multi-genotype experiment with allele-resolved SNP genes.
simulate_ambient_cohort()
Simulate a large case/control cohort at the pseudobulk level.
simulate_ambient_study()
Simulate a case/control single-cell study with sample-specific soup.
simulate_de()
Self-contained pseudobulk DE simulator with three gene classes: null : no difference anywhere true_de : differs in NATIVE expression between conditions (real signal) ambient_de: native identical, but SOUP differs between conditions (a trap)
simulate_experiment()
Simulate a contaminated droplet experiment with known ground truth.
simulate_multimodal()
Multi-sample, splice-resolved contaminated experiment with ground truth.
soup_eb()
Empirical-Bayes soup profiles per sample.
soup_profile_error()
Soup-profile recovery error.
species_mix_hidden()
Hidden-species view of a mixture: one species' cells, only its genes.
species_mix_truth()
Ground-truth contamination from a two-species mixture.
split_droplets()
Split a raw droplet matrix into cells and empty droplets.
summarise_benchmark()
Aggregate to mean +/- sd per (method, soup_bias).
